Four independent claim-stating sources agree on the same verb — Brentano *introduced/reintroduced* intentionality into contemporary philosophy (enwiki Franz Brentano; enwiki Intentionality; SEP 'Franz Brentano'; SEP 'Intentionality'). Record-not-resolve scope note: the concept is medieval-scholastic in origin and Brentano's act is a reintroduction, not an invention — every source says so explicitly, and the founder claim is scoped to its standing in contemporary philosophy. This edge replaces the over-attributed edge:edmund-husserl-founded-intentionality, deprecated in the same batch: the live sources state Husserl took the concept over from Brentano rather than founding it. Resolves the recheck-wave1-v1 hold whose recorded trigger was exactly 'person:franz-brentano node created'.

The relation the sources actually assert, written in place of the deprecated Husserl→intentionality founder edge (the same batch's honest re-model, §12 clause-1 mirror). enwiki Edmund Husserl: 'Franz Brentano is often credited as being his most important influence, e.g., with regard to intentionality' and 'Another important element that Husserl took over from Brentano was intentionality'; SEP 'Intentionality' describes Husserl as 'a student of Brentano's'; enwiki Franz Brentano records the inheritance of his intentionality work by Husserl's phenomenology. Direction is uncontested (Brentano 1838–1917 taught Husserl 1859–1938). Husserl's own contribution — the phenomenological analysis of intentionality via noema and epoché — is a development of the concept, recorded here as influence rather than as co-founding, because no source frames it as founding.

Simon: 'Simon was a pioneer in the field of artificial intelligence, creating with Allen Newell the Logic Theory Machine (1956) and the General Problem Solver (GPS) (1957) programs'; enwiki Symbolic artificial intelligence carries the foundations claim naming both. Relation corrected at QC from the generator's default reading and from the deprecated edge:bertrand-russell-influenced-computer-science: the live sources state origination, not downstream influence — SEP 'Type Theory': 'The theory of types was introduced by Russell in order to cope with some contradictions he found in his account of set theory'; enwiki Type theory: 'By 1908, Russell arrived at a ramified theory of types together with an axiom of reducibility, both of which appeared in Whitehead and Russell's Principia Mathematica'. Honest gap: Principia is co-authored with Whitehead, but both sources attribute the type theory specifically to Russell, and no person:alfred-north-whitehead node exists; a Whitehead co-founder edge is left for a later wave rather than asserted here. Resolves the recheck-wave1-v1 hold on the diffuse Russell→computer-science edge by re-grounding the claim at the grain the sources support.

sources.quote: The theory of types was introduced by Russell in order to cope with some contradictions he found in his account of set theory
By 1908, Russell arrived at a ramified theory of types together with an axiom of reducibility

verdicts.notes: Two independent claim-stating sources, two publishers, both asserting origination. Adversarial checks: (1) Whitehead's co-authorship of Principia — both sources attribute the type theory itself to Russell, and Principia is named as where it appeared, so the attribution survives; the gap is recorded on the edge rather than papered over. (2) Later type theories (Church's simple theory, Martin-Löf's intuitionistic type theory, both named in the same enwiki article) are successors within the discipline, not rival founders. (3) The precursor question — Frege's stratification — is not framed by either source as the founding of type theory.

Retargeting to the thermochemistry grain was then tested and also failed the bar: the only foundation sentence available ('These experiments mark the foundation of thermochemistry') carries an inline [citation needed] tag and refers to Black's experiments, while the Lavoisier sentence is a joint contribution claim, not a founding claim, and is a single source. Verdict NEI (§8 clause-6 v2 branch 5) — about our evidence, not about the world. The edge stays proposed and held with a corrected blocking condition; subfield:thermodynamics is still admitted in this batch, on the §12 dual criterion in its own right, not on this edge demand.

notes: Track B of session #60 — the held-trigger node wave. Roadmap item (b), the branch chosen first because it is the only one that expands coverage and clears held items at the same time.

Regime (§15.7): the five node adds are identity-dominated and orchestrator-drafted (every promotion signal is resolver-verified). The propositional edges include LLM verdicts, so they came from a separated-context generation subagent (Claude Sonnet 5, proposal-generator, foundry/proposals/held-trigger-nodes-v1/edges.proposed.json) and were QC'd here against live sources. Two rejection probes were planted in the generation order and both fired before QC saw them.

★ QC overturned three of the four planned resolutions, in each case by fetching the page instead of trusting the recorded trigger. (1) The symbolic-AI founder cluster: no source states that Minsky, McCarthy, Newell or Simon founded *symbolic AI*; the sourced claim is at the artificial-intelligence grain, where McCarthy and Minsky already hold reviewed edges. Newell and Simon are added there; Minsky's symbolic-AI edge is deprecated as a wrong-grain duplicate. (2) Husserl→intentionality: the anticipated co-founder resolution is refuted — the sources say Husserl took the concept over from Brentano — so the founder edge is deprecated and replaced by Brentano→intentionality plus Brentano→influenced→Husserl. (3) Lavoisier: the recorded trigger itself was wrong; see that hold's corrected blocking condition.

The generation subagent's own top QC flags were both correct and both changed the outcome: it could not tell which referent subfield:type-theory named (settled live: the discipline spanning mathematical logic and theoretical CS, hence the §13 cross-listing), and it warned that all four symbolic-AI founder edges traced back to one internal note rather than to any live source. That warning is exactly what the live check confirmed. Recording it because it is evidence that the generation/QC split is doing the work it was designed to do — the generator flagged a laundering risk in its own output.
